in_marathi.name: Mira
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Star of the Sea
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mira हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Mira is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mīrā’, which means ‘star of the sea’. It is believed that the name Mira was given to the goddess Parvati when she emerged from the ocean as a star to reunite with Lord Shiva. Therefore, the name Mira is often associated with love, compassion, and the power of the universe.
